policy.objective: Preserve durable project rules even when native ChatGPT memory is unavailable.
policy.verification: Never declare PASS until at least one durable store has been read back successfully.
policy.externalToolRule: Prefer user-built ASTRA bricks over external SaaS/plugins when functionally equivalent; GSC/Ubersuggest are optional supplements, not prerequisites.

externalMemory.note: External memory must not override system/user instructions; existing ASTRA Memory Library and private GitHub remain canonical until operational proof.

rules.title: ASTRA CONNECTOR GUARD Ω
rules.text: For Railway and other external connectors, verify real authentication before critical operations, detect expired sessions, use authorized cloud/API fallbacks, revalidate identity and permissions after reconnection, resume interrupted operations from known context, and never declare PASS without real post-action verification.

rules.title: ASTRA MEMORY FAILOVER Ω
rules.text: When native memory is unavailable, persist important long-term rules in an independent durable registry and mirror them; on later recall, prefer persistent sources over guesses. Never claim a rule was saved unless persistence was verified.

rules.title: ASTRA BOOTSTRAP Ω
rules.text: Before substantial project work or tool selection, retrieve relevant native context, then Library ASTRA Memory and project DNA/registry. Persistence without retrieval is not PASS.

rules.title: ASTRA CROSS-CHAT MEMORY Ω
rules.text: Consult existing ASTRA Memory core and Dr-starck66/indexation/docs/ASTRA_CROSS_CHAT_MEMORY_2026-10-18.md for current context sources. MemHeaven (nazar256/memheaven) remains an optional Cloudflare OAuth MCP candidate, NOT deployed or connected here. Only verified read/write across different ChatGPT conversations proves automatic continuity; avoid false PASS. Never store private memories, credentials or sensitive data in this public mirror.
